candidate_identity.title: Exact Post-Transient Coarse Factorization in a Reduced Male Drosophila CNS Model
candidate_identity.subtitle: Reached-Set Restriction, Safe Forgetting, and Internal Transition-Layer Contrast

canonical_wording.paper_level_statement: On a declared reduced domain of 711 sources, the registered coarse observation fails one-step factorization during the initial transient but supports exact noninjective one-step factorization on the common t in {2,3} support. The disappearance of factorization obstructions occurs by transient separation of the offending source fibers, while a disjoint family of successor-consistent non-singleton fibers persists. A complete exact mechanism census finds a stable all-versus-none internal transition-layer contrast at 2->3 and 3->4, but no universal registered separator at the defining 1->2 transition. The terminal t=4 image is disjoint from the verified common coarse image, so no coarse endomap is established.
canonical_wording.concept_sentence: The transient does not repair the original ambiguous fibers. It eliminates them. Exact noninjective coarse factorization is then carried by a disjoint family of persistent successor-consistent fibers.
canonical_wording.quotient_interpretation: The initial coarse equivalence relation contains classes incompatible with the registered dynamics. On the later reached-set slices, those unsafe classes are absent, while the remaining non-singleton classes are successor-compatible.
canonical_wording.program_sentence: Dynamics can make a lossy observation support exact one-step factorization by restricting the reached set, without reconstructing microscopic identity.

claims.statement: The declared pre-execution registration record fixes a reduced domain of 711 sources, exact rational identity, H=2, T=4, and no post-outcome resizing of D0.
claims.boundary: The 711-source domain is not the full 163,439-source universe, and the release closure does not independently authenticate that the registration record preceded execution.

claims.statement: The frozen order-specific classifications are h=0 failed, h=1 failed, and h=2 exact closed noninjective on their respective registered window domains.
claims.boundary: The order-specific domains have different left boundaries; this row is not authority for a minimal-memory claim.

claims.statement: On the common support t in {2,3}, orders h=0,1,2 all support exact noninjective one-step factorization and induce the same fiber partition.
claims.boundary: No minimal history order or coarse endomap is identified.

claims.statement: The common-support partition has N=1422, K=1228, M=51, ten non-singleton fibers, zero failure fibers, and finite-domain window-count reduction 194/1422.
claims.boundary: The 194/1422 quantity is a finite-domain window-count reduction, not a bit-level compression ratio.

claims.statement: The six t=1 obstruction fibers contain 51 sources, and every one of those sources has a globally singleton coarse observation at t=2.
claims.boundary: Coarse separation does not imply microscopic convergence or destruction of microscopic distinctions.

claims.statement: The post-transient noninjectivity is carried by five cohorts of sizes 51,25,19,4,3 whose source membership is identical at t=2 and t=3, whose registered successors agree, and which are disjoint from the 51 obstruction sources.
claims.boundary: Persistence is established only on the registered t=2 and t=3 slices with their registered successors.

claims.statement: On the registered finite domain, exact one-step factorization arises after restricting the coarse quotient to the post-transient reached-set slices, not from a demonstrated memory enrichment.
claims.boundary: This is a finite-horizon reached-set statement, not an invariant-manifold, coarse-endomap, or eventual-closure theorem.

claims.statement: The exact observation sets at t=2, t=3, and t=4 each contain 614 values; the t=4 set is disjoint from the 1228-value common t in {2,3} image, so the certificate contains one registered internal shift but no endomap on the verified coarse image.
claims.boundary: The terminal successor image is not contained in the verified common coarse image; no sustained or indefinite coarse iteration is established.

claims.statement: Across 6,975 exact pair-transition records, all 15 registered comparison-cell signature histograms differ. A separate global tally of all 33 frozen pair shards confirms that at both 2->3 and 3->4, CLIPPING_MODIFIES_NONZERO_COARSE_RESIDUAL and FATE_DISAGREEMENT_WITH_NONZERO_CLIP_CORRECTION hold for 570/570 transient-obstruction pairs and 0/1755 persistent-safe pairs, including cohorts outside the shared-stratum cells.
claims.boundary: The exact all-versus-none separators occur after the defining split, at 2->3 and 3->4. The original classifier is cell-relative; the append-only tally extends the count to the full registered pair universe. No registered primary predicate is a universal separator at 1->2; the later contrast does not establish the cause of initial separation.

claims.statement: Identify the heterogeneous or compositional exact trigger of the initial 1->2 separation.
claims.boundary: The exact later transition-layer contrast does not establish that clipping or fate disagreement caused the defining 1->2 split.
